title: 波が戻る
subject: a tide returning
caption: Post-rock, largely instrumental. Two tremolo-picked electric guitars build from a single clean arpeggio to a wall of delayed and overdriven sound, bass swelling underneath, drums entering with mallets and finishing on full crashes. Wordless layered humming floats over the middle; one sung line arrives only at the end. Cavernous reverb tails, very wide stereo image. 70 BPM, D major. Patient, building, finally bright. no pop, no vocal-led chorus.
